# Exercise 4: Take me to the clouds above

<br>

The final task is deploying an app.

- Create a new repository and upload one of the apps you've created in the last few exercises to GitHub.

- Deploy your app to the streamlit community cloud
    - Remember to include a `requirements.txt` file

If you finish this,

- Try uploading some more apps
- Go back to any exercises you want to spend more time on
- Or start building an app of your choice!
